summary:
I found no Lane C news (a named next-gen drug with a new result or regulatory step that first went public within 48 hours) for today, 2026-10-26. I checked retatrutide, CagriSema, survodutide, amycretin, MariTide, EloraTZP and orforglipron, and nothing qualified.

**Retatrutide sleep apnea:** Medscape picked it up again today. But the NEJM papers aren't new: one source dates them to Sept 29 and another to Oct 20. Treat it as a peaking topic that has already been covered. It doesn't count as Lane C.

**Three upcoming events for Lane C, each a candidate below:**
- Lilly's Q3 earnings call (reported for Oct 29). Expect updates on the retatrutide filing and the EloraTZP Phase 3 start.
- The EU Commission's decision on Foundayo (orforglipron) for both weight and type 2 diabetes. The CHMP recommended it on Oct 15.
- The FDA's CagriSema decision, which Novo has guided to Q4 2026. No PDUFA date has been confirmed.

Write the decoder scripts now so the long-form can go up the same day the news breaks.

**Today's top new topic is ACOG's first guidance on GLP-1 medicines in pregnancy and breastfeeding.** Healio and ACOG covered it Oct 22–23, and CBS and Yahoo picked it up today. It is mainstream, very searched, has few dedicated explainers, and fits our women 25–45 audience. Present it strictly as clinician guidance, with no stopping instructions for viewers.

**Second is nutrient gaps on GLP-1 medicines** (protein, vitamin D, iron). The Hill and NewsNation covered it today, Medscape earlier, plus a review in Clinical Obesity. It works as the hook for the Lane A long-form "Protein on Tirzepatide".

**For no-news days:**
- Long-forms: "What Is CagriSema?" as the decoder, ahead of the FDA decision. Then Lane A topics: protein and nutrients, and what happens when you stop tirzepatide.
- Funnel Short: EloraTZP. ClinicalTrials.gov now lists its first Phase 3 trial (NCT07881432), with an estimated start in December 2026.
- Body-worry Shorts: bones, nausea.
- Gray-market Short: the compounded tirzepatide recall, at most one this week.

Two topics are rejected again: GLP-1 microdosing and retatrutide research-chemical sourcing.

candidates.topic: GLP-1 medicines and pregnancy: ACOG's first-ever guidance on semaglutide and tirzepatide before conception, in pregnancy and while breastfeeding (released Oct 22–23, 2026; CBS and Yahoo, Oct 26)
candidates.why_now: This is the first US professional-society guidance on the topic, and it went mainstream today through a CBS segment and Yahoo. It extends our earlier snapshots on the WSJ breastfeeding story and the JAMA data showing a 24-fold rise among new mothers. Women of reproductive age are a large, fast-growing share of GLP-1 users, and it has very few dedicated YouTube explainers yet.

evidence.signal: Official new guidance on GLP-1 use in pregnancy and lactation
Calls the ACOG guidance 'long-awaited'; covers pregnancy and lactation
Mainstream TV segment on the new guidance
International consensus (Obesity Reviews, July 29, 2026): don't deliberately continue in pregnancy; reassurance after accidental early exposure

candidates.topic: Protein, vitamin D and iron gaps on tirzepatide or semaglutide: what the new nutrient-deficiency data show (The Hill and NewsNation, Oct 26; Medscape; Clinical Obesity review)
candidates.why_now: The Hill and NewsNation ran it today. Medscape and a narrative review in Clinical Obesity cover the same ground, and the September pediatric study from Northwestern keeps it in the news. It is the exact Lane A topic the playbook names, and the search phrase "protein on tirzepatide" is evergreen.

evidence.signal: 'Ozempic users may face protein, vitamin D deficiencies, experts warn'
'What Nutrients Are GLP-1 Users Lacking?'
Micronutrient and nutritional deficiencies linked to GLP-1 therapy
Study: GLP-1 drugs may raise the risk of key nutrient deficiencies

candidates.topic: Lilly's Q3 2026 earnings call (reported for Oct 29): pipeline updates expected on the retatrutide filing (Q1 2027), the EloraTZP Phase 3 start and orforglipron indications
candidates.angle: A Lane C pre-position, not a stock story. Draft a "What Lilly just confirmed about retatrutide and EloraTZP" long-form now. Publish only if the call or its press release adds a new, dated pipeline fact, such as a filing submitted, a Phase 3 started or a new indication. The script states the drug's status in the first 30 seconds and never mentions share prices.
candidates.why_now: A 24/7 Wall St. preview flags Oct 29 as a catalyst. Lilly most recently said it plans to file retatrutide in Q1 2027. Earnings releases routinely bring new, dated pipeline steps, which is exactly what Lane C needs, and they can be scripted ahead.

evidence.signal: '3 Massive Catalysts That Could Ignite an Eli Lilly Stock Rally on Oct 29'
Retatrutide met its Phase 3 goals; Lilly plans to file with the FDA in 2027

candidates.topic: EloraTZP (eloralintide plus tirzepatide) moves toward Phase 3: first Phase 3 trial listed on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07881432, adults with obesity without type 2 diabetes, estimated start December 2026). Drug Topics recap Oct 24; Chosunbiz Oct 25
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–3 weeks (and again when Phase 3 starts in December)
candidates.why_now: The registry entry and Korean press coverage (Oct 25) show Lilly advancing the combination. It's a new, dated fact for a drug where our live video ranks with almost no competition.

evidence.signal: NCT07881432: EloraTZP in adults with obesity without type 2 diabetes
Phase 2 results; Phase 3 of a co-formulation planned by end of 2026
'EloraTZP Shows Greater Weight Loss, A1C Reduction Than Tirzepatide'
EASD 2026: the combination beat tirzepatide alone

candidates.topic: What is CagriSema? A decoder ahead of the FDA decision Novo expects in Q4 2026 (submitted Dec 18, 2025; no PDUFA date confirmed). Includes the REDEFINE 1 menopause-stage post hoc: about 25% average weight loss versus 3% on placebo at 68 weeks
candidates.predicted_peak: Any day through December (the FDA decision)
candidates.why_now: A TradingView weekly recap (Oct 26) highlights the Q4 FDA decision. An approval would be the biggest Lane C event of the quarter, and a decoder already published would catch the search spike.

evidence.signal: 'Phase 3 CagriSema efficacy and FDA decision due Q4'
NDA submitted Dec 18, 2025; decision guided to Q4 2026; no PDUFA date confirmed

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) in Europe: the CHMP recommended approval for type 2 diabetes and weight management on Oct 15, 2026, and the European Commission's decision is pending. EASD data also showed cardiovascular safety comparable to insulin glargine (Neurology Advisor, Oct 26)
candidates.angle: Lane C trigger watch. When the Commission issues its decision, publish "Orforglipron approved in Europe: what the pill does for type 2 diabetes". Note that in the US it is approved for weight management only (April 1, 2026). Until then, use it only as a factual line inside other pieces ("CHMP recommended… Commission decision pending"). Orforglipron Shorts have underperformed (39 and 40 views), so prefer the long-form plus the live Orforglipron video for the funnel.
candidates.predicted_peak: When the Commission decides (usually weeks after the CHMP opinion)
candidates.why_now: A dated regulatory step is pending, and today's EASD coverage of its heart safety keeps orforglipron in the news.

evidence.signal: CHMP positive opinion, Oct 15, 2026
Lilly's GLP-1 pill wins European backing for obesity and diabetes
EASD: daily orforglipron showed cardiovascular safety comparable to insulin glargine

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide: how much of the weight lost is muscle? The SURMOUNT-1 body-scan substudy, plus the semaglutide handgrip meta-analysis (Diabetes Obes Metab, Oct 19) and the new wave of 'muscle-sparing' add-on news (Earth.com, Oct 24)
candidates.angle: An outcome-question Short in the format that got 131 and 102 views: "How much of the weight lost on tirzepatide is muscle?" Answer it with the body-scan data, then point to the live long-form Strength Training on Tirzepatide as the 20:00 funnel. Mention the experimental muscle add-ons only as investigational. No how-to list.
keywords: how much muscle do you lose on Mounjaro
candidates.predicted_peak: Evergreen; renewed by each new muscle-drug readout
candidates.why_now: Seen in 11 straight snapshots with momentum rising to 72. Earth.com (Oct 24) and Fox local syndication ("Ozempic butt" muscle drug) keep the worry in mainstream news. It feeds the Strength Training long-form, which is still growing.

evidence.signal: Meta-analysis of handgrip strength after semaglutide
'New therapy may prevent muscle loss from weight-loss drugs'
'Worried about Ozempic butt?' muscle-loss coverage

candidates.topic: What happens when you stop tirzepatide? SURMOUNT-4 regain data, the real-world persistence study (Diabetes Obes Metab, Oct 19), the discontinuation and switching patterns paper, and Drug Topics on adherence (Oct 26)
keywords: what happens when you stop tirzepatide
candidates.why_now: Steady at about 70 across 10 snapshots. A fresh Drug Topics adherence piece today and two new persistence and discontinuation papers give it a news hook. The playbook names it as a Lane A title.

evidence.signal: Real-world semaglutide initiation behaviours, early discontinuation and 1-year persistence
Discontinuation, restarting and switching of semaglutide and tirzepatide in obesity
'How GLP-1 Adherence Rates Are Tracking Today'

candidates.topic: Retatrutide for sleep apnea: TRIUMPH-1-OSA (243 adults, no diabetes) and TRIUMPH-2-OSA (448 adults, type 2 diabetes), BMI 27 or higher, NEJM. Renewed pickup from Medscape (Oct 26), EMJ and Medical Xpress (Oct 24)
candidates.angle:
Peaking, so differentiate. Shorts only:
- "Retatrutide versus tirzepatide for sleep apnea: what each trial measured". Separate trials, not head-to-head, with the same measure on both sides.
- Or a funnel Short pointing to the live Retatrutide long-form.
Check the NEJM online date before writing "new": one source says Sept 29 and another Oct 20.
candidates.why_now: Medscape covered it again today, so the story is moving from medical to mainstream news. Retatrutide Shorts are our highest peaks (257 and 197). It doesn't qualify as Lane C because it first went public more than 48 hours ago.

evidence.signal: 'Investigational Med Tied to Major Reduction in OSA Severity'
Triple-action weekly drug reduces sleep apnea in two late-stage trials
Tirzepatide for OSA review (the comparator side)

candidates.topic: Compounded tirzepatide vials from a Cary, North Carolina compounder recalled nationwide over sterility doubts, with no illnesses reported (Medical Daily, Oct 26; Dallas News, Oct 24; The Hill on the FDA recall of 22 vials)
candidates.angle: Gray-market "what's confirmed?" Short, the one allowed this week: "Compounded tirzepatide recalled: what's confirmed?" Cover the dated recall facts, that no illnesses were reported, and how to check a recall notice. Point viewers to a prescriber about FDA-approved options. Never name, link or rate any seller, and use no emoji. Short only (Lane B long-form is closed).
candidates.why_now: It's a new recall with a date, carried by several outlets over 48 hours. Gray-market "what's confirmed?" Shorts have a median of about 105 views.

evidence.signal: Nationwide recall of compounded tirzepatide vials over sterility doubts; no illnesses reported
Compounded GLP-1 injections recalled over sterility concerns

candidates.topic: Do GLP-1 medicines affect your bones? A new systematic review of skeletal effects in adults with overweight or obesity (Arch Osteoporos, Oct 23, 2026)
candidates.angle: A calm 08:00 "honest uncertainty" body-worry Short, our Instagram winner: "Does tirzepatide or semaglutide weaken bones?" Say what the review found, how much is still unknown, and why protein, strength training and calcium and vitamin D from food help. Use tirzepatide in the title only where the review covers it.
candidates.why_now: A fresh systematic review that hasn't been widely covered yet. The nutrient-deficiency story (vitamin D) makes it a natural pair.

evidence.signal: Systematic review of the skeletal effects of GLP-1 receptor agonists in adults with overweight or obesity

candidates.topic: Nausea on tirzepatide: why trials may undercount it, and what helps (Diabetes Obes Metab narrative review of patient-reported outcome gaps, Oct 22; Neurogastroenterol Motil review of GI symptoms and motility; The Conversation, Oct 22)
candidates.angle: An honest-uncertainty Short: "Is nausea on tirzepatide more common than the trials say?" Explain how the trials measured nausea, list the evidence-based easing habits (smaller meals, eating slowly, stopping before full, avoiding greasy food), and say when to call your prescriber. Short only, because the 10-24 side-effects long-form already covers this.
candidates.why_now: Steady at 74–77 across 8 snapshots, with two fresh reviews and The Conversation piece. The "stomach side effects" Reel reached 103 on Instagram.

evidence.signal: Narrative review: how well nausea is measured in GLP-1 obesity trials
GI symptom events and motility changes linked to GLP-1 receptor agonists

candidates.topic: Do 'GLP-1 supplements' work like semaglutide or tirzepatide? Berberine, fibre, probiotics and 'GLP-1' drops and patches (Reuters via Japan Today, Oct 23; Fortune, Oct 22), with FDA warning letters
candidates.angle: A myth-correcting Short: "Can a supplement do what tirzepatide does?" Compare the trial-scale weight loss with the much smaller evidence behind supplements, then cover the real natural GLP-1 supports (protein, fibre, eating order), which don't replace the medicine. Name no products.
candidates.why_now: Reuters and Fortune are covering it, TikTok is pushing these supplements, and the FDA and ACP are pressing for tighter rules.

evidence.signal: Doctors and regulators raise flags as weight-loss drug users turn to supplements

candidates.topic: Semaglutide for alcohol use disorder: a Lancet RCT found fewer heavy drinking days (108 adults with obesity, 26 weeks, plus CBT), Medical Economics recap Oct 25; Heineken document on GLP-1s and beer sales (Reuters, Oct 23)
candidates.angle: The "beyond weight" pillar: "Can semaglutide cut heavy drinking? What one trial showed." Cover the population, the add-on CBT, and the fact that it is not approved for this use. The Heineken document is the hook. The playbook bans single-trial deep dives on approved drugs, so this is a Short, with tirzepatide named only if there's tirzepatide data.
candidates.why_now: The RCT and the Heineken document are both in news cycles, along with the BMJ coverage of the addiction trial.

evidence.signal: Morning update: 'semaglutide cuts heavy drinking'
Heineken document reveals worries over weight-loss drugs and beer sales

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide or semaglutide: protein first, smaller plates, eating slowly and easing nausea at big holiday meals (UC Davis Health guide; Men's Health chef piece, Oct 26)
candidates.angle: A seasonal life-on-GLP-1 piece: "Thanksgiving on Tirzepatide: How to Enjoy It Without Feeling Sick." Cover why a big meal can feel different (slower stomach emptying) and practical plate-building ideas, with no extreme-diet messaging. Schedule for mid-November.
candidates.why_now: Search demand builds every year from the start of November. A Men's Health piece from a chef on a GLP-1 (Oct 26) and the Food Institute's food-trend piece add hooks.

evidence.signal: 'I'm a Chef on a GLP-1. I Believe the Future of Food Is About to Change Dramatically'

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide plus ixekizumab for psoriasis with obesity: TOGETHER-PsO found 30.6% reached complete skin clearance plus at least 10% weight loss at 52 weeks, versus 4.4% on ixekizumab alone (Medical Economics recap Oct 25; 1-year data from Sept 2026)
candidates.angle: A beyond-weight head-to-head-style Short: "Does tirzepatide help psoriasis?" Name the population (psoriasis plus obesity), give both arms, and note that the combination is investigational for this use and inflammation findings were exploratory.
candidates.why_now: Medical Economics resurfaced it on Oct 25. Psoriasis plus obesity is a large audience with few GLP-1 creators covering it. The data aren't brand-new, so it's not Lane C.

evidence.signal: TOGETHER-PsO links obesity treatment to better psoriasis clearance
Ixekizumab plus tirzepatide sustains 1-year gains

candidates.topic: REJECT: 'GLP-1 microdosing' and self-titration content (ongoing Vogue/Yahoo/India Today search churn), plus retatrutide 'research-grade' sourcing and quality-checklist content
candidates.angle: Not for production. If the topic must be addressed, fold one line into other pieces: "Dose changes are for you and your prescriber. Unapproved retatrutide isn't a legal or tested product." Never make a dedicated microdosing or sourcing explainer.
candidates.why_now: It keeps appearing in search-spam feeds and lifestyle press. It's banned by our guardrails (no microdosing or self-titration, no gray-market sources).

evidence.signal: 'vogue microdosing weight loss drugs tirzepatide'
